passage: Last Friday, I finished work at six and hurried to the train station. I looked up the timetable on my phone and wrote down the platform number. The hall was crowded, so I slowed down and looked around for the ticket gates. I checked in at the machine, picked up my ticket, and walked over to platform three. The board showed that my train was delayed by twenty minutes. I sat down on a bench, called my wife, and filled her in. She asked me to pick up some fruit on the way home. After a while, the train pulled in, and everyone stood up and got on. I found a seat by the window and put my bag down. The train started, then slowed down again between two stations. A conductor walked through and pointed out that the next stop was closed, so we had to get off at the one after it. I ended up thirty minutes late. When I got off, I picked up some apples at a small shop and headed home. I dropped the bag off in the kitchen and sat down for dinner. I smiled, because I had made it back safely.

coach_rationale: 今早直查了 drill_sessions：有分听写仍是 7 次，最近一次仍是 10-22，样本未增加。EnglishPod365 仍无带 error_types 的新记录，主弱项继续是过去式 -ed 听辨和短语动词连读，所以今天继续把这两类靶子埋进短文。这篇「下班后火车晚点了」是全新的旅行话题，短文里有 finished/hurried/looked/slowed/checked/picked/walked/showed/delayed/called/filled/asked/started/pointed/closed/ended/headed/dropped/smiled 等规则过去式；looked up、wrote down、slowed down、looked around、checked in、picked up、walked over、sat down、filled in、pulled in、stood up、got on、put down、pointed out、got off、ended up、dropped off 是今天的短语动词连读靶子。难度保持听写 B1、跟读 A2。
